# Downloading a toolchain should honor GOFLAGS=-modcacherw.
# See also install_modcacherw_issue64282.txt.

[!exec:/bin/sh] skip 'the fake proxy serves shell scripts instead of binaries'

env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.21actual
env GOTOOLCHAIN=auto
env GOFLAGS=-modcacherw
env TOOLCHAINDIR=$GOPATH/pkg/mod/golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.999testmod.$GOOS-$GOARCH

cd m

# A switch triggered by the toolchain line in go.mod.
go version
stderr '^go: downloading go1.999testmod \(.*/.*\)$'
stdout go1.999testmod
cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $TOOLCHAINDIR/extraneous.txt
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
go clean -modcache
env GOTOOLCHAIN=auto

# Flags unknown to this toolchain must not prevent the switch.
env GOFLAGS='-modcacherw -thisflagdoesnotexist'
go version
stderr '^go: downloading go1.999testmod \(.*/.*\)$'
stdout go1.999testmod
cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $TOOLCHAINDIR/extraneous.txt
env GOFLAGS=
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
go clean -modcache

# A switch requested by GOTOOLCHAIN.
env GOFLAGS=--modcacherw=true
env GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.999testmod
go version
stderr '^go: downloading go1.999testmod \(.*/.*\)$'
stdout go1.999testmod
cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $TOOLCHAINDIR/extraneous.txt
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
go clean -modcache

# With -modcacherw=false, the toolchain is read-only.
env GOFLAGS=-modcacherw=false
env GOTOOLCHAIN=auto
go version
stderr '^go: downloading go1.999testmod \(.*/.*\)$'
stdout go1.999testmod
[!GOOS:windows] [!root] ! cp $WORK/extraneous.txt $TOOLCHAINDIR/extraneous.txt
! exists $TOOLCHAINDIR/extraneous.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module m

go 1.21
toolchain go1.999testmod
-- $WORK/extraneous.txt --
This is not a Go source file.
